[[Barcelona Sporting Club|Barcelona]] was the defending champion. ==Format== On the night of January 8, 2013, the [[Ecuadorian Football Federation]] determined that the format for 2013 would be the same as the previous season. ==Teams== Twelve teams will compete in the 2013 Serie A season, ten of whom remain from the previous season. [[Club Deportivo Técnico Universitario|Técnico Universitario]] and [[Centro Deportivo Olmedo|Olmedo]] were relegated last season after accumulating the fewest points in the [[2012 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A#Aggregate table|2012 season aggregate table]]. They will be replaced by [[Universidad Católica del Ecuador|Universidad Católica]] and [[Club Deportivo Quevedo|Deportivo Quevedo]], the 2012 [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] winner and runner-up, respectively. Both teams are making returns to the Serie A.
